items.evidence: All eight labware loaded with the specified load names, slots and labels; p20 left and p300 right with tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Steps 1-10 use the specified volumes. Primers go A1-G1 and A2-G2 to pcr_plate A1-G1, and templates are A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1; the end-state checks pass.
The 19 uL water, 5 uL rCutSmart and 1 uL DpnI additions are made to A1:G1 and mixed. The 37/65 C incubation and the Zymo clean-up are recorded in comments with a pause, in the specified order.
Each assembly gets 7 uL water, 2 uL buffer, 3/2/3 uL of fragments 2/5/6, 2 uL of fragments 1/3/4/7 and 1 uL enzyme mix, matching the task. The assembly_plate end-state check passes.
The Step 25 comment records 30 cycles of 37 C for 5 min then 16 C for 5 min, then 60 C for 5 min, a 4 C hold and an 85 C lid, followed by a pause.
5 uL of each assembly goes to cells_plate A1:D1. The ice, heat shock and recovery steps are recorded, and 250 uL LB+dextrose is added on the p300. The cells_plate end-state check passes.

The send() helper uses a new tip per transfer for primers, templates and fragments, and the no_cross_contamination check passes. Tips are reused only for single-source reagent distribution, as in the reference.
Volumes of 20 uL or less go on the p20 and larger ones on the p300. Pauses are added at the manual steps and no tip is left on the pipette. All checks pass.
The step order matches the task and the comments are accurate. The only differences are the 10 uL mix volume at step 24 and the extra pauses, both of which are reasonable.

judge.summary: The protocol follows all 33 steps in order with the correct labware, volumes and pipette choices. All measured checks pass, and the manual steps are recorded in comments with operator pauses. I found no meaningful deviations.
